rules.content:
/*
Ransomed.vc extortion group
*/

rule Ransomed_Note
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.ransomed"
        description = "Detects Ransomed.vc extortion note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "ransomed.vc" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "Ransomed" ascii nocase
        $s3 = "ransomed.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
